title: Women’s Pole Vault World Rankings, November 2026
desc: The ten highest-ranked women in pole vault in the World Athletics edition of 17 November 2026, ordered by ranking points.

source.name: World Athletics — Women’s Pole Vault World Rankings
source.note: On 21 November 2026 (Korea time), the AllRanks assistant (Codex) checked all ten names, federation codes, places and scores against the World Athletics table dated 17 November. The snapshot covers places 1–10 by ranking points. Molly Caudery placed tenth with 1,273 points, two ahead of Emily Grove. The scores measure ranking points, not vault heights.
